 Influencer Liam Fitzgerald dies from injuries after motorcycle crash, girlfriend says 
 RELATED VIDEO: Here’s a look at some of the most notable deaths in 2026. (Source: AP Images, CNN Newsource, MGN Images, Canva, DCC Gray News) By Debra Worley Published : Nov. 1, 2026 at 1:27 AM CDT Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google (Gray News) – Liam Fitzgerald, an influencer with more than 1 million followers , died from injuries suffered in a motorcycle crash, his girlfriend said in a post on social media.
 “It is with the heaviest heart that I share the devastating news that Liam passed away following a motorcycle accident on Oct. 30 at approximately 2 a.m.,” Jamie Lynrin said .
 Lynrin said he had severe injuries, and “despite the efforts of those who tried desperately to save him, they were unable to bring him back.”
 Liam Fitzgerald died from injuries sustained in an early-morning motorcycle crash on Oct. 30, girlfriend Jamie Lynrin announced on social media. (Liam Fitzgerald via Instagram) Fitzgerald posted about fitness, personal brands and finance. According to his website, he offered one-on-one fitness and social media coaching.
 “There are no words to describe the heartbreak of this loss,” Lynrin said. “This is an incredibly difficult and heartbreaking time for everyone who knew and loved him.”
